I can help you troubleshoot this issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
Sure, my name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal or connectivity. This is due to an overdue bill from your January billing cycle.

I’ve just sent you a payment request for the overdue amount of $65. Please check your payment requests and complete the payment. Once the bill is paid, I can help you restore your service. Let me know once you’ve made the payment or if you need further assistance with the process.

history.content: I just rebooted my phone, but I still don’t have any signal. There are no bars at the top and I still can’t get online.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let's troubleshoot your phone's connectivity step by step.

First, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- “No SIM” or “SIM error” message
- Any signal bars at all (even 1 bar)
- Any network type indicator (like 5G, 4G, LTE, etc.)

This information will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
Actually, I now see excellent signal bars, 5G, data enabled, and it shows connected to Chestnut-5G in the status bar. What should I do next to confirm everything is working?

That’s a great sign! Your phone now shows excellent signal, 5G connectivity, and mobile data is enabled. To confirm everything is working:

1. Try making a regular phone call.
2. Open your browser or an app and check if you can access the internet without Wi-Fi.
3. Try sending a picture message (MMS) to ensure multimedia messaging works.

If all these functions work, your service has been fully restored. If you encounter any issues with calls, data, or picture messaging, let me know which one isn’t working and I’ll help you troubleshoot further.
I just tried all three: I made a call, got online using mobile data, and sent a picture message. Everything is working perfectly now—thanks for your help!
You’re very welcome! I’m glad everything is working perfectly now. If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
